annotations.title: Look up nonprofit IRS / California good standing by EIN

description: Check a US nonprofit's standing by EIN against the IRS auto-revocation list (tax-exempt status revoked for three consecutive missed Form 990 filings) and California Registry of Charities delinquency/suspension lists. Returns revocation and reinstatement dates, whether the streamlined 15-month reinstatement window is still open, and whether AB 488 requires fundraising platforms to block donations. A "clear" result means the EIN is on none of the tracked lists.

ein.description: The organization's 9-digit EIN, with or without a dash, e.g. "12-3456789".
